sources.title: Lars Hörmander, Fourier integral operators. I, Acta Mathematica 127 (1971), 79–183
sources.used_scope: Section 2.2, printed 110–112: positivity factor and compactness direction; Section 4.3, printed 181: graph compactness and norm modulo compact operators. The referred external converse is not adopted.

access_note: Exact earlier verified free snapshot reused; the new reading is limited to the listed pages. No source listed only in its bibliography is adopted.
reuse: Independent proofs, exposition, examples and figure; no source expression or PDF redistributed. Exact earlier components retain their terms.
component_terms: CC0 original exposition, complete proofs, solved examples and vector figure; exact earlier components retain their separate terms.
proof_policy: Every result used is proved here or at an exact earlier programme proof; a source citation replaces no proof.

validation.filter_test_scope: Shifted Gaussian Fourier inversion checks normalization and the input/output sign only. The theorem uses compact smooth F; the numerical test does not certify its symbol support or compactness.
